title: SpaceX Historic Launch Stunned Viewers as Alleged 'UFO' Flew by on Livestream: 'We Just Saw an Alien Mothership'
description: A mysterious object seen during SpaceX's historic Starship Flight 14 livestream prompted UFO speculation, but no evidence links it to extraterrestrial technology and conventional explanations remain possible.

title: Mysterious 'UFO' spotted on SpaceX livestream sparks alien theories
